hypothesis: Diagnosing specific clarity problems before making targeted revisions may preserve readable original prose while improving the passages that require editing. Detector impact is a separate unproven outcome.
intervention: Frozen installed skill plus a diagnose-then-targeted-edit workflow. No production rewriting-rule change before measurement.
comparison: Two new synthetic technical fixtures; unchanged original versus one targeted revision per case. This tests the combined editing workflow against no edit, not its superiority to the current skill or a single instruction ablation.
case_selection: Two deliberately constructed factual originals with concrete clarity problems, from official docs. New development fixtures, not naturally occurring questions or an unseen validation dataset.
writer: Fresh context writer sees frozen skill, question, original and source evidence, no prior detector outputs. Save diagnosis and first final candidate.
review: Separate score-blind reviewer assesses baseline and exact final candidate, facts, clarity, tone and required qualifiers; also reconstructs conclusion/action/limiting condition. LLM judgment, not human preference.
repair_policy: At most one pre-score factual repair per case; retain failed original candidate and review. No post-score edits in this batch.
detectors: Pangram 4.0 free text detection in Chrome
GPTZero Basic Scan current displayed model in Chrome
budget: Only existing free allowance; last observations 8 Pangram credits and1794 GPTZero words, recheck live. Inspect exact input fit and quoted scan costs before final admission; do not truncate/pad or buy/bypass limits.
representation: Preserve original files and identical source content including code. Record submitted and observed effective bytes per detector and precise whitespace/display transformations.
stop: After the four planned inputs on each service, or a confirmed service/allowance barrier. Preserve all ties, regressions, warnings and unmeasured cells. Positive results justify a later replication rather than a broad claim.

scan_order.reason: Reverse original/revision order between cases; same order on both detectors; fixed before measurements.
